notes: Communication on hydrogen generation by homogeneous iridium-catalysed solvolysis/hydrolysis of ammonia borane (a chemical hydride). The only hydrogen quantities are volumes of H2 released, read from a water-filled graduated cylinder or burette (main p. 2: 'evolution of hydrogen, which was measured in a water-filled graduated measuring cylinder'; SI p. 2, Hydrogen Measurement Experiments). No sorbent takes up H2 from the gas phase and no carbon sorbent or surface area appears; carbon nanotube adsorption is mentioned only as a cited storage technology (ref. 4). Not computational and not electrochemical, so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated. Primary research article with data; not retracted (record is_retracted false, no retraction notice); no duplicate-data statement.
